description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation = one outer sample; the outer L1's score for a candidate is a COMPOSED fitness (per campaign.json::scoring, computed by inner_recursion._compute_proxies) — not one number thrown away from a signal-rich campaign. Shape = lift core x bounded quality modulator x efficiency modulator: ((normalized_gain+1)/2) * max(0.6, cleanliness*diversity_health) * (0.7 + 0.3*clamp(delta_per_dollar/6)). GOVERNING LAW: every term must carry a CANDIDATE GRADIENT (vary across the meta-prompt candidates being compared) — the two proxies retired earlier (a rounds-to-target counter and a per-seed cost multiplier) died precisely because they were constant across candidates or a seed-property, so a flat term earns nothing and is cut in tuning. LIFT CORE: normalized_gain = best-discovered depth as a fraction of the room available to move it, after_n / max(origin, 1-origin). This removes origin-strength bias so a config compares across inner benchmarks of different difficulty, and — because levels live in [0,1] and the denominator is therefore never below 0.5 — it is bounded in [-1,1] BY CONSTRUCTION: no clamp, no degenerate denominator. It normalizes to the real CEILING. There is NO target score anywhere in this system, and none should be re-introduced: declaring one asserts up front how much room the benchmark has, and that assumption was both unused (it carried no candidate gradient) and wrong to make — a task the inner model looks bad at is a task it has not been TUNED for yet, not a task with a low ceiling. Be optimistic about the room to improve unless the evidence is unambiguous. It reads the inner cycle's best-DISCOVERED candidate (θ-LCB of the best candidate the inner search FOUND, discounted by its SE), NOT the best it CROWNED — the crowned frontier lags at small inner budgets, so the discovered level is the sensitive signal. The whole trajectory is ONE space (θ-implied ability where the ruler is warm, else raw accuracy) so no delta subtracts across scales; levels are NOT floored at origin, so a regressing meta-prompt yields a negative delta the outer steers away from (recentred (delta+1)/2 so regression<no-op<improvement stay distinct). QUALITY MODULATOR (penalties modulate, never dilute — floored at 0.6 so a broken campaign is discounted <=40%, never sign-flipped): cleanliness = 1 - mean-per-round(inner degraded/unscoreable rate + meta-fault self-heal rate + the outer meta-prompt's own malformed-output rate) — the self-heal rate is the share of a round's inner candidates that tripped self-healing for a meta-prompt-owned reason (any validation failure e.g. a hallucinated node, or an operator-terminal runtime failure), so any inner self-heal is transmitted upward as a penalty; a transient-transport self-heal is owner=L1 and excluded (provider noise, not the meta-prompt's fault); diversity_health = 1 - mean-per-round(no-op+duplicate share) penalizes mode collapse. EFFICIENCY MODULATOR: delta_per_dollar = best-depth / inner cost_usd — candidate-specific numerator, so (unlike the retired per-seed cost multiplier) it carries a gradient: a verbose meta-prompt burns more for the same lift and scores lower. EMITTED BUT HELD OUT of the v1 formula until a validation read confirms candidate gradient here (avoids re-baking a flat term): rounds_improved_frac, delta_per_candidate, delta_per_second, after_N_rounds_delta (the un-normalized numerator of normalized_gain, kept as a raw observation), and first_round_delta (collinear with normalized_gain — max(levels) includes levels[0], so whenever round 1 is the best round the two terms double-count one number; re-admit only if a validation read shows early-speed variation the core misses). ACCEPTANCE is empirical: the composed fitness must hold the C3 gate proxy_lift_corr>=0.6 — a term that degrades it is dropped. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7: the inner model is far from what prompting can get out of it there, so meta-prompt quality has room to show. (gsm8k was retired for the opposite reason — its inner loop had nothing left to climb.) Improvement on this benchmark is real but INFREQUENT: a candidate that fails to move a seed is weak evidence, not proof the seed has no room. n_samples_per_inner_round = 24, scored IN FULL per candidate (inner_recursion sets sp_budget_ttest = bank size): drawing more than we score just widens the θ-LCB and starves the signal, so draw == measure. Do NOT thin it: PoBB eliminates losers early (~14 samples), so only the WINNER is scored on the full bank — and the winner's θ-LCB is exactly the number normalized_gain reads. Cutting 24->18 buys ~7% of inner wall time (backend calls are only ~29% of it; ~62% is optimizer latency) and pays ~15% wider SE on the one statistic that matters, so it is a strict loss. ROUND BUDGET = max_inner_rounds (the CEILING) x inner_lives (the stall brake: +1 per improving round, -1 per stall, stop at 0): a compounding inner campaign banks its way toward the ceiling, a fully-stalling one dies after `start` rounds, so depth is bought only where it pays. INVARIANT: `start` must sit WELL BELOW max_inner_rounds. Set near it (it was start:5 against a ceiling of 7) the bank cannot drain before the calendar cap unless the inner stalls from round 1, so every inner runs full-length regardless of quality — which ALSO flattens delta_per_dollar, since a meta-prompt that finds nothing then burns the same rounds as one that compounds, and a flat term earns nothing (see the governing law above). Lives is the escalation-proof brake: an L2/L3 fire resets l1_stall_count but never the bank. inner_n_variants MUST be >=2, else each inner round explores a single candidate and the discovered `levels` trajectory degenerates. PANEL = every seed 0-10, and sp_budget_ttest tracks it. Sized well above the elimination_n_min (6) coverage floor so a single errored inner campaign cannot drop the round under it (arm A lost seed-5 to an uncaught empty l2_context response and the round went sub-floor), and — the reason it is this wide — because inner stochasticity is the binding constraint on the outer signal: the run-to-run swing of a cell measured twice under the SAME meta-prompt is the floor every candidate verdict must clear, and the only lever on a panel MEAN is cell count. No seed is screened out: a seed draws a FIXED 24-sample subset (random.Random(seed).sample), so a strong-origin seed is a HARD cell — informative, not broken. Added depth roughly doubles inner spend, so the outer spend cap (campaign.json::spend_budget_usd) is sized to fit. An inner cycle carries NO spend or token cap of its own: an instrument's budget is its ROUND budget, which is deterministic and is exactly what these proxies are defined over. A cost/token cap trips on MEASURED token counts, which jitter run to run (reasoning tokens are not reproducible), so the same meta-prompt halted at a different round on different runs — and the resulting truncated trajectory is indistinguishable from 'this meta-prompt found nothing', which made provider mood a fitness signal (measured: 3 of 36 inner cycles tripped token_budget, two truncating at rounds 4-5 of a 7-round budget, every one scored as a verdict). What bounds an inner cycle instead: the round budget; every individual await inside it; the outer sample's wall-clock deadline, which EXCLUDES the cell as missing data rather than scoring a truncated one; and the outer campaign's own spend cap, which every inner dollar rolls up onto — the operator's cost ceiling belongs at the level where the operator set one, not inside the instrument. GENERAL LAW: a safety rail firing must be a DISTINGUISHABLE OUTCOME, never a corrupted measurement — only a SUCCESS-outcome inner cycle (it ended on its own terms) is scored at all; HALTED/FAILED/PAUSED are excluded as missing data, loudly, and never routed to the floor (the floor is normalized_gain=-1, which zeroes the cell and would punish a meta-prompt for a slow provider).
